notes: Metro Nashville-Davidson County base zoning (Open Data, ArcGIS Online org of NashvilleOpenData). Covers Nashville/Davidson County; satellite cities (Belle Meade, Berry Hill, Goodlettsville, etc.) excluded. ZONE_DESC holds the district code (RS10, CL, MUG-A...). ORDINANCE is an ordinance number, not a URL. Overlay districts are a separate layer and are not included.
